Late Night Ramen [HORROR]
深夜拉麵

Congratulations, you've been hired! 🍜

Your new job is at a ramen shop that stays open 24/7...
The job listing warned it wasn’t a “normal” place - but you weren’t prepared for what you were about to see.

You must determine which customers are NORMAL and which ones are ANOMALIES.
Too many mistakes can end your shift.

✅ Serve normal customers
❌ Close the window on anomalous customers
📝 And follow THE RULES to survive

👥 1–4 Players (best with friends!)
🛒 Earn income from serving ramen, and buy boosts in the Shift Shop
❓ This is not a normal ramen shop... will you survive?
